definitions.explanation: The branch of physics dealing with the relationship between electricity and magnetism, or the phenomena themselves.

examples.japanese: {電磁気|でんじき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法則|ほうそく}→法則：05143_housoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: To learn the laws of electromagnetism.

examples.japanese: {電磁気|でんじき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{物理学|ぶつりがく}→物理学：09631_butsurigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧だ。
examples.english: Electromagnetism is an important field of physics.

examples.japanese: マクスウェル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方程式|ほうていしき}→方程式：04795_houteishiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電磁気|でんじき}⟦{現象|げんしょう}→現象：02718_genshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{統一的|とういつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記述|きじゅつ}した→記述する：17347_kijutsusuru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: Maxwell's equations are a unified description of electromagnetic phenomena.

notes:
A compound of {電|でん} (electricity) and ⟦{磁気|じき}→磁気：03334_jiki⟧ (magnetism). Often encountered in the longer form ⟦{電磁気学|でんじきがく}→電磁気学：29784_denjikigaku⟧ (electromagnetism as an academic discipline).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電磁気学|でんじきがく}→電磁気学：29784_denjikigaku⟧: electromagnetism (academic discipline)
- {電磁気|でんじき}⟦{現象|げんしょう}→現象：02718_genshou⟧: electromagnetic phenomena
- {電磁気|でんじき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧: theory of electromagnetism
- {電磁気|でんじき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法則|ほうそく}→法則：05143_housoku⟧: laws of electromagnetism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電磁波|でんじは}→電磁波：17900_denjiha⟧: electromagnetic wave — a specific phenomenon resulting from electromagnetism
- ⟦{磁気|じき}→磁気：03334_jiki⟧: magnetism — one component of electromagnetism
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧: electricity — the other component of electromagnetism
